title: Wake the Kaiju
parents: Scrub the Kaiju (server goal + wake reveal)
Raise the Server Baby (server feeds it → evolution)
Feed a Creature (taste deduction, wrong food = chase)
Keep It Alive bloodline (mini-kaiju eggs for top contributors)
loop: 100 players pressure-wash one skyscraper-sized sleeping monster; clean zones pay coins and barnacles roll treasure. When it is clean it wakes; then the server FEEDS it for 5 minutes: right foods (learned by watching what it spits out) raise an evolution meter, wrong foods make it swat and chase. What the server fed decides which of 3 forms it evolves into. Top scrubbers/feeders get an egg that hatches a mini-kaiju pet that scrubs beside you.
twist: One giant shared pet per server whose species is decided by the crowd's food choices; every reveal is a cutscene the whole server watches.
money: Turbo Nozzle (grime), Golden Feed (your feed counts ×5, fires during feed phase), Godparent Chest ×2 (at evolution countdown), Summon Legendary Kaiju (server flex), pet egg luck (odds shown)
evidence: Cleaning wave: Wash The House 31.5K CCU, Clean all the Leaves ~86.8K CCU; server-goal co-op: Build the Pyramid! 13.15M visits since Sep 3 2026; Creature Kitchen 99% positive 7,392 Steam reviews
roblox_occupancy: no shared-pet game found (fact-checked 9/30); no kaiju-washing game found (9/27)

title: Hatch It Early
parents: Freeze-Dry Your Candy (timer + push-your-luck early open + friend luck)
Keep It Alive (permadeath, oldest-pet flex, bloodline)
Read Your Pet's Diary (narrated offline life)
loop: Eggs incubate on timers. Open on time for a normal hatch, or open EARLY for a shot at a MEGA (giant/shiny) hatch at the risk of a dud. Friends standing at your incubator add luck. Hatched pets need care; neglected pets can die (softly: to the Rainbow Garden, revivable 24h) and their children carry traits. Pets live an offline life and hand you a diary when you return.
twist: Push-your-luck hatching plus pets that can actually be lost — the flex is your oldest pet and its family tree, not a drop table.
money: Stable Shell (no dud on early open — fires before the risky open), Instant Hatch (timer), Medicine (death screen), Auto-Feeder 3d (logout), Lifespan Elixir, egg luck (odds shown)

title: Lure the Night Visitors
parents: Stock a Bird Feeder (offline visitors, squirrel raids)
Befriend the Thing Under the Bed (decor as lure)
Read Your Pet's Diary (narrated overnight log)
loop: Decorate a backyard and bedroom. By day, feeders and seed lure birds; by night, lamps, snacks and socks lure cozy creatures from under the bed and porch. Every item changes spawn odds. Creatures you befriend become room/yard pets earning coins. Other players can join as raccoons to raid your yard at night; you build baffles. When you log in you get a 3-panel diary of what visited overnight.
twist: Decor IS the gacha (you tune odds by what you place), with a real day/night cycle and an offline reveal that brings players back.
money: Rare Lure candle (odds shown), Premium Seed, Night Skip, Baffle Repair (after raid), 24h Offline Camera, +Room/Yard
evidence: Birdbuddy smart feeders: TIME Best Inventions 2023, $2.5M Kickstarter 2025, Birdbuddy 2 preorders sold out CES 2026; Rescue Pets 10.8M proves cozy creature care

title: Chop the World Tree: One of Us Is a Termite
parents: Chop the World Tree (server tree, peg-board drops, fall cutscene)
Find the Key, One of Us Hid It (hidden traitor in a co-op task)
Hunt the Top Roller (bounty crown)
loop: 100 players chop one giant tree; chips fall through branches (peg board) into rarity bins. One or two players are secretly Termites: they can gnaw a bin to steal 20% of its drops and plant rotten chips. Every 5 minutes a vote can exile a suspect; a correct exile shares their stolen loot. The rarest-drop holder wears a bounty crown.
twist: Turns a pure co-op grind into social deduction; the fall cutscene doubles as the round reveal.
money: Lucky Axe, Canopy Chest ×2 (fall countdown), Termite role pass (higher chance), Vote Shield, Auto-Chop

title: Own a Candy Lab
parents: Freeze-Dry Your Candy (timer + push-your-luck)
Unwrap the Golden Ticket (scarce hourly tickets → carry-and-steal → factory run)
Swap Hour trading
loop: Buy candy bags (shop restocks every 5 min); pieces drop through the peg sorter into dryer trays; open early for MEGA puffs at collapse risk. Inside bags, 5 Golden Tickets per server per hour: grab one, glow, run to the Factory Gate while others try to steal it; inside is a 90s bonus run with exclusive candies. twist: Two proven engines in one candy town: push-your-luck crafting for solo players and a public chase for the social crowd.
money: Stable Door (before early open), Instant Dry, Escort Shield (on ticket grab), Factory Retry, Mutation Syrup, Sugar Rush (server)

title: Draft an Ugly Dog
parents: Bid for Fighters (auction draft, equal budgets)
Win the Ugly Dog Contest (vote-defined value, genetics)
Keep It Alive bloodline
loop: Every hour a litter of 12 puppies goes to auction; every player gets the same budget of Bones; bid live for the ugliest-looking genes.
